title: B1 service-worker push + subscription + B2 dispatcher Notifikace
tests_added: OrderCard.test.tsx (+4 red-icon: seeded-before, sent-only, no-cache, reactive-after-mount)
notes: SW STRATEGY: switched vite-plugin-pwa from generateSW to injectManifest (strategies:'injectManifest', srcDir:'src', filename:'sw.ts'). Custom src/sw.ts owns: precacheAndRoute(self.__WB_MANIFEST); Web Push display from {title,body,url,tag,priority}; notificationclick focus/open url; OfferToDriver (priority high / tag 'offer') -> requireInteraction:true. injectManifest traps handled: self typed via `declare const self: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope` + `/// <reference lib=webworker />` (skipLibCheck absorbs the DOM/WebWorker self overlap); must reference __WB_MANIFEST or build fails. devOptions.enabled:false kept (SW never registers in dev/Playwright — harness untouched). ADVISOR-CAUGHT REGRESSION FIXED: generateSW options (navigateFallback/denylist) do NOT carry over to injectManifest, so I re-added a workbox-routing NavigationRoute(createHandlerBoundToURL('/index.html')) with denylist [/^\/api/,/^\/hubs/] in sw.ts for offline deep-route reloads (spec §11), plus the SKIP_WAITING message listener that registerType:'prompt' needs to activate an updated SW (generateSW used to inject it). workbox-precaching + workbox-routing resolve transitively (verified present). SW push->sound: the SW cannot play audio; for an offer it postMessage({type:'push-offer'}) to clients, but NO client listener consumes it yet (dead message, documented) — in-app offer sound is already owned by useOfferSound via SignalR; the SW's real job is requireInteraction + focus. VAPID KEY SOURCE: read from import.meta.env.VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY via shared/push/pushConfig.getVapidPublicKey() (isolated module so tests vi.mock it — vi.stubEnv does NOT reach import.meta.env in this vitest config, and import.meta.env is not shared across module boundaries, both verified empirically). No real VAPID key hardcoded; prod wiring deferred to assignment 08. SUBSCRIPTION WIRING: usePushSubscription() hook — ensureSubscribed() feature-detects (SW+PushManager+Notification), decides via pure decideSubscribe (skip-unsupported/denied | resync-existing | subscribe±prompt), subscribes through registration.pushManager, POSTs to /push/subscriptions; unsubscribeLocal() unsubscribes+DELETEs. Driver: MANDATORY at login — wired as a useEffect in DriverHomePage (the real post-login landing at /d; PermissionPriming.tsx was defined but rendered nowhere, so I did NOT attach to it — that would be dead code). Customer: PushPrompt accept now calls ensureSubscribed (was client-permission-only). client.ts gains PushSubscribeRequest + pushSubscribe/pushUnsubscribe (typed client, no raw fetch). CONTRACT ASSUMED (Lane A not yet present on disk — built to the A2/A6 handoff-designer shapes, client mocked in tests): A2 POST/DELETE /push/subscriptions body {endpoint,p256dh,auth,userAgent?}; A6 OrderDetailDto.notifications: OrderNotificationDto[] where item = {event,channel('Sms'|'Push'),recipient,status('Queued'|'Sent'|'Failed'|'SkippedCap'|'SkippedNoChannel'),error?,createdAt,sentAt?}. OrderNotificationDto is defined once in shared/notifications/notificationStatus.ts and re-exported from client.ts; OrderDetailDto.notifications is additive-optional (mirrors ratingStars? pre-merge pattern). B2 NOTIFIKACE: NotificationsSection lives in features/orders/ (the OrderDrawer is features/orders/OrderDrawer.tsx — the WI's features/board/orderDetail/ path is STALE; placing it in board would be a banned cross-feature import). Renders event (Czech label)+channel+status pill (tone not color-alone, role='status')+recipient+Europe/Prague time; failed item shows provider error. notificationStatus.ts (PURE, in shared/ because consumed by BOTH features/orders NotificationsSection AND features/board OrderCard) = statusDescriptor/channelLabelKey/eventLabelKey/hasFailedSms. FAILED-SMS RED ICON on OrderCard: reads the order-detail cache via useQuery({queryKey:['orders','detail',id], enabled:false}) — REACTIVE (re-renders when detail lands later) but NEVER fetches (no N-query board storm, web-performance#query-keys). Icon = ✉︎⚠ with i18n aria-label 'SMS se nepodařila odeslat...'. CROSS-LANE FOLLOW-UP (honest gap, NOT a bug): true at-a-glance-across-the-whole-board requires OrderSummaryDto (the LIST projection) to carry a hasFailedSms flag from the backend — A6 only added `notifications` to OrderDetailDto, so the card icon appears only after that order's detail has been loaded once (into the ['orders','detail',id] cache). Recommend an A-lane list-DTO hasFailedSms flag in a future UC. SETTINGS SMS PANEL: smsCostDisplay.ts (PURE) computes count*unitCost + cap level (ok/near≥90%/over≥100%); FleetTab renders count+estimatedCost (formatCzk Intl cs-CZ currency, integer CZK)+cap+near/over warning (role=alert). FleetSettingsDto extended additively-optional with smsMonthlyCapCzk/smsUnitCostCzk/smsSentThisMonth; panel is HIDDEN unless all three are present (backend FleetSettings endpoint does not yet expose them — assumed additive; degrades cleanly). fleetSettingsMapper + view-model extended to carry them. i18n: added top-level `notifications` block (title/empty/failedSmsIcon/statusOf/status.*/channel.*/event.*/settings.*) to BOTH cs.json+en.json (formal customer tone N/A here — dispatcher surface; driver path has no new UI strings). locales.parity.test passes. QUALITY GATE: tsc 0, lint --max-warnings 0 clean, vitest 1001 passing 0 failures, build OK (dist/sw.js generated, injectManifest, 30 precache entries, NavigationRoute present), size 227.45 kB < 260 kB budget. Staged web/ only (excluded web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo); did NOT commit; did NOT touch api/** or .claude/state pipeline.
